games.name: Music
games.desc: Play your own songs with a glowing visualizer. Keeps playing while you game, and comes back to the same spot in the song.

games.name: Notes
games.desc: Write anything. Saves while you type, and puts your cursor right back where it was.

games.name: Calculator
games.desc: A calculator with science buttons, history, and keyboard typing.

games.name: Drawing
games.desc: Draw, paint and fill. Use your drawing as the picture for any game.

games.name: Gallery
games.desc: All your screenshots, recordings, drawings and photos, newest first. Look at them big, download them, or use one as a game's picture.

games.name: Video
games.desc: Watch your recordings, your own videos and YouTube links. The mini player floats over your games.

games.name: Timer
games.desc: Timers, a stopwatch with laps, and alarms. They ring over your games, even when this app is closed.

games.name: Code
games.desc: Write HTML, CSS and JavaScript and see it live. Examples and lessons inside. Save what you make as a real game or app.
